author: HID production runtime applicability assessment
hid_scope: gateway image only; exact libssl3 and libcrypto3 3.5.9-r1 aarch64 Alpine 3.24.2 purls; original findings retained in grype.raw.json; no risk-acceptance waiver

statements.impact_statement: The affected code is OpenSSL's DANE verification in a TLS client (SSL_dane_enable and SSL_dane_tlsa_add). nginx has no DANE support and never acts as a TLS client here (every upstream is http://), and libapk's manifest run enables no DANE. The gateway image (nginxinc/nginx-unprivileged@sha256:782bb897..., Alpine 3.24.2, arm64) serves through nginx 1.30.7-r1 with gateway/nginx.conf.template: one plain-HTTP listen 3000 with no ssl or quic parameter, and every proxy_pass target is an http:// *_UPSTREAM value, so nginx never creates a TLS or QUIC session. No load_module directive exists, so the njs, xslt, geoip and image-filter modules are never loaded. The only other OpenSSL user that runs is the entrypoint's apk manifest (libapk imports only digest, PEM key and TLS-client symbols, and makes no network connection there); the wget health check is plain http://127.0.0.1:3000. As rechecked on 2026-11-19, no nginx, module or njs ELF imports OSSL_QUIC_*, CMS_*, PEM_X509_INFO_* or SSL_new_listener. Assessed 2026-11-22; approved by the owner, Q136 A, 2026-11-22. Rechecked 2026-11-25 for libssl3 and libcrypto3 3.5.9-r1 (Alpine v3.24/main, built 2026-11-18, aports 0f4c7e8d0f5f), pinned in gateway/Dockerfile: its only patches fix CVE-2026-88822, CVE-2026-88823, CVE-2026-95691, CVE-2026-95692 and CVE-2026-107496 (bss_dgram, AES-GCM-SIV, QUIC CRYPTO frame reassembly, EC key generation) and leave this code unchanged, and the nginx, module, njs, libapk and ssl_client imports are unchanged; moved to 3.5.9-r1 as approved by the owner, Q292 A, 2026-11-25.
